name: classifieds
market: United States, mid-sized metro area, pragmatic internet users
density: Intentionally minimalist to the point of seeming broken to modern eyes. Plain blue hyperlinks on white backgrounds. No images on listing pages. Bullet-point lists of categories. No CSS grid or flexbox — old-school HTML structure. The entire page fits above the fold with no scrolling needed on desktop.
nav_style: No persistent navigation. The homepage IS the navigation — a two-column list of all categories. Each category links to a flat listing page. Search bar at the very top. Post listing button prominent.
commercial_model: Free for most listings. Paid for job postings and apartment listings in major markets. No display ads. No tracking pixels. The business model is visible through a simple fee schedule page.
color_palette: Pure white (#FFFFFF) background. Standard hyperlink blue (#0000EE) for unvisited links, purple (#551A8B) for visited. Black (#000000) text. Zero decorative color. Occasionally a light green (#D3FFD3) row highlight for featured listings.
typography: System default serif: Times New Roman on Windows, Times on Mac. No font declarations — pure browser default. Small text, 13px. No web fonts, no Google Fonts, no icon fonts.

pages.title: Local Classifieds
pages.description: Two-column category list covering housing, jobs, for sale, services, community, gigs, and discussion forums. Search bar at top. City selection.

pages.title: Housing
pages.description: Apartment listings as plain text list. Each entry: price, bedrooms, neighborhood, date. No images on index page. Pagination at bottom.

pages.title: Jobs
pages.description: Job listings sorted by category: accounting, admin, education, food, retail, tech, etc. Plain text list with date and area.

pages.title: For Sale
pages.description: Items for sale in sub-categories: furniture, electronics, bikes, clothing, free stuff, barter. Very dense plain text list.

pages.title: Community
pages.description: Community boards: local news, lost & found, missed connections, rants & raves, volunteers, activities, rideshare. Discussion forum layout.
